parsed.explanation: For n=2, Liu’s proposed marks produce lengths 1/5, 1/5, 3/5. Xiang may bisect the 3/5 segment, yielding sorted lengths 3/10, 3/10, 1/5, 1/5. Alternating optimal claims give Liu 3/10+1/5=1/2, below 3/5. Thus the proposed strategy does not prove the universal lower bound, and no other passage supplies the required all-n argument. Repair requires replacing the strategy with the geometric division and adding a universal pairing/tree, majorization, or induction lemma.
